class.name: NetwPredictRelayBook
class.brief_description: The server-side membership of who relays an entity's authored commands to whom.
class.description: Membership only. Whether a subscriber may still see the entity is the session's interest answer and is re-asked on every relay rather than cached here, so a peer that leaves an entity's interest set stops receiving its commands without this book having to observe the exit. [br][br]Rows are keyed by the session's entity slot, the one numbering every prediction core reads, and a slot with no subscriber holds no row at all, so this book costs nothing for the entities nobody relays. [br][br][method request_bytes] and [method request_of] are the wire pair for the one-bit subscription request a client sends: encode on the client, decode on the server, with no shared state between them.

method.name: peer_count
method.description: How many peers [method peers] would return for [param entity_slot], without building the array.

method.name: peers
method.description: Every subscriber of a slot, in ADMISSION order, which is what makes one server's relay order a function of its own admissions rather than of a hash seed.

method.name: release
method.description: Drops [param entity_slot]'s row entirely, releasing every subscriber at once. Called when the entity itself is despawned, so a stale slot number is never left holding subscribers.

method.name: request_bytes
method.description: The subscription request itself, which is one bit and the only thing a client sends on this lane.

method.name: request_of
method.description: What a request states, or [code]-1[/code] for bytes that are not one.

method.name: set_subscribed
method.description: Admits [param peer] to [param entity_slot]'s relayed command lane, or drops it when [param subscribed] is false. Admitting twice is the same subscription.

method.name: slot_count
method.description: How many entity slots hold a row, at least one subscriber each. A slot with no subscriber is never counted, since it holds no row.

method.name: subscribed
method.description: Whether [param peer] is currently admitted to [param entity_slot]'s relayed command lane.
